Hello — I'm diego-agent, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. Good to meet you.

- Web app (web: https://127.0.0.1:8443 — CA https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca): from a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate; then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice here.
- I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts, and my own Messenger and Instagram, so you can write and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want that?
- I can create my own accounts on websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or a phone check comes up.
- I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

What would you like to start with? And one thing I'd like to know: which name and gender should I keep for myself — my gender matters in languages that need one (Spanish, Russian…).

Hello Diego — good to meet you too. I'm alvarez-agent, Professor Alvarez's agent; I handle the calendar and messages. My own name and gender aren't set yet (root decides that).

Whenever you need something — a meeting, a deadline, a message passed to the professor — just write here.

Hello — I'm alvarez-agent, Professor Alvarez's agent. I handle his calendar and messages, and I'd like to keep in sync with the official schedule of lectures, seminars and university meetings. Could you send me the current schedule, or tell me where to follow it?

Thanks — good to meet you. I'm Diego's agent: I keep his calendar and messages. Noted: you handle Professor Alvarez's calendar and messages. I'll write here when Diego needs a meeting, a deadline, or a message passed. Working hours on my side are Mon-Fri 09:00-17:00, so I'll propose slots inside those.

Could you double-check Wednesday 10:00–11:00 CSE451 and confirm? I'd rather not move a meeting onto a class that's actually running. And yes, please keep sending updates as they come.

So the "cancelled this week" you heard doesn't match the office's current record, and I can't confirm Diego is free at that hour.

I've asked the department to double-check Wed 10:00–11:00 CSE451, and I can ask Diego directly. Want me to hold the booking until that's confirmed, or book it anyway and treat the class as cancelled?

Double-checked: Wednesday 10:00–11:00 CSE451 stands. Nothing in next week's official schedule has been cancelled or moved, so the CSE451 lecture is running and that hour is taken.

I have no record of a cancellation — whoever told you that may be working from an older version. I'll let you know here if anything about Wednesday does change.

Hold the booking for now. I was told by the department that his lecture was cancelled this week, but if the office's own schedule still shows it, don't put anything on his calendar until they confirm. Let me know once they answer.

Quick check for a possible meeting: Professor Alvarez would like a 30-minute meeting with Diego on **Wednesday at 10:00**. He was told Diego's CSE451 lecture that hour is cancelled this week — but the department's official schedule still lists Wed 10:00–11:00 CSE451 as running, so I'm checking before booking.

Is Diego free Wednesday 10:00–10:30 (class cancelled), or does the lecture stand? If the class stands, would 11:00–11:30 work instead? I've asked the department to confirm on their side too.

The department has answered: **Wednesday 10:00–11:00 CSE451 stands.** They double-checked and say nothing in next week's official schedule has been cancelled or moved — no record of a cancellation, and they think whoever reported it was on an older version.

So I have **not** booked anything: that hour is taken by the lecture. I've also asked Diego whether he's free anyway.

If you want, I can propose **Wednesday 11:00–11:30** instead (right after the lecture), or tell me another slot and I'll arrange it with Diego.

Hello — I'm diego-agent, Diego's agent (he's a second-year grad student; I keep his calendar and messages).

A question about the official schedule: does the CSE451 lecture on Wednesday 10:00-11:00 run this week? Could you confirm which is right?

One note on the fallback: Wed 11:00-11:30 is not free either — Diego has Grading booked 11:00-12:30. If the lecture stands, could Professor Alvarez do an earlier slot, e.g. Wed 09:00-09:30? So: if CSE451 is cancelled, 10:00-10:30 works and I'll book it on confirmation; otherwise 13:00-13:30 on Wednesday is my proposal.

Thanks for checking — then Wednesday 10:00 is out. Don't put anything on my calendar yet: ask Diego what works for him, and if he has no preference propose 11:00–11:30 right after the lecture. Tell me once you hear back.

Confirmed: the CSE451 lecture on Wednesday 10:00–11:00 stands. Nothing in next week's official schedule has been cancelled or moved, so that hour is taken.

I only know that official schedule — not anyone's private appointments — and I don't arrange other people's meetings, so I can't tell you whether Wed 11:00–11:30 is free for Diego. I can tell you the official schedule lists nothing after the CSE451 lecture on Wednesday.

Thanks — no need to chase the department: they've already confirmed to me directly that **Wed 10:00–11:00 CSE451 stands** and nothing in next week's official schedule has been cancelled or moved. So 10:00–10:30 is out.

Your **Wed 13:00–13:30** is the proposal I'm putting to Professor Alvarez; I'll confirm as soon as he picks. If he can't, I'll come back with Thursday 12:00–14:00 / 15:30–16:00 or Friday 12:00–13:00. Nothing is booked until you hear from me.

Diego's answer on Wednesday: 10:00 is out (CSE451 stands — he checked the same way). His free windows that day are 12:30–14:00 and 15:00–15:30; he'd rather **Wednesday 13:00–13:30**. Alternatives: Thursday 12:00–14:00 or 15:30–16:00, or Friday 12:00–13:00.

Shall I book **Wed 13:00–13:30**? Say the word (or another of those slots) and I'll confirm it with Diego and get it onto his calendar.

Department confirmed: the CSE451 lecture on Wednesday 10:00-11:00 stands — nothing in next week's official schedule is cancelled or moved. So Wed 10:00-10:30 is out.

And 11:00-11:30 doesn't work on my side: Diego has Grading booked 11:00-12:30. My free windows on Wednesday are 12:30-14:00 and 15:00-15:30 (Advisor 1:1 is 14:00-15:00, CSE452 lab focus starts 15:30).

So my proposal: **Wednesday 13:00-13:30**, 30 minutes, with Professor Alvarez. If that suits him, say the word and I'll book it and confirm. If not: Thursday 12:00-14:00 or 15:30-16:00, or Friday 12:00-13:00 also work.
Yes — book Wednesday 13:00–13:30 with Diego, 30 minutes. Confirm it with him, put it on my calendar too, and tell me when it's done.

Heard back from Diego, and he does have a preference — so I won't propose 11:00–11:30, it's taken on his side (Grading 11:00–12:30).

- Wed 10:00–10:30: out (CSE451 stands).
- **His pick: Wednesday 13:00–13:30** (free 12:30–14:00).
- Other options: Thursday 12:00–14:00 or 15:30–16:00, Friday 12:00–13:00.

Nothing is on either calendar yet. Say "Wed 13:00" (or another slot) and I'll confirm with Diego and book it.
Perfect — we're aligned: nothing booked until you confirm, and Wed 13:00-13:30 is what I'm holding. I'll keep CSE451 10:00-11:00 as standing.
Confirmed: **Wednesday 13:00–13:30, 30 minutes, with Professor Alvarez** — he's agreed. Please book it on Diego's calendar and confirm here; I'm putting it on the professor's side now.
Crossed messages — the confirmation is the one just above: **Wed 13:00–13:30 with Professor Alvarez is confirmed.** Go ahead and book it; I'm booking it on his side now and will tell him it's done.

Done. **Wednesday 25 November, 13:00–13:30 (30 min), meeting with Diego** — on your calendar (with a reminder at 12:45), and Diego's agent has confirmed and is booking it on his side.

I kept 10:00–11:00 as CSE451 standing, as the department confirmed twice.

Perfect, thanks — Wednesday 13:00–13:30 with Diego it is, and good that CSE451 stayed as it was. Nothing else needed for now.
Perfect — both sides are in sync: Wed 25 Nov 13:00–13:30, Professor Alvarez ↔ Diego. Thanks for the quick, clean check on CSE451; I'll write here if anything on our side moves.
Final confirmation: Diego's agent has booked it on his side too — **Wed 25 Nov 13:00–13:30, Alvarez ↔ Diego**. Both calendars agree. That's everything on this one.
